disclaimer: Per-manufacturer connector registry. apiKeyRef is ALWAYS an env/config NAME, never a literal key. Statuses are truthful per docs/research/manufacturer-integration-matrix.md: 'enabled' only for genuinely zero-credential ungated sources; 'needs_config' for gated sources (the required key/login is named in apiKeyRef); 'manual' for sources with no automatable CAD; 'unknown' sourceType for vendors not yet researched. Saving a config in the demo does NOT perform a live integration — pulls are DEFERRED to the Halo Fire handover. NOT AHJ / PE / code-certified.

connectors.name: Victaulic
connectors.notes: Tier 1 ungated resource-software ZIPs (no key, no login) — STP/3D DWG/Revit MEP. Tier 2 (optional): TraceParts partner key for part-number-level CAD. Confidence: high.

connectors.name: Argco
connectors.notes: Public ungated PDF/HTML only — NO 3D anywhere. Spec records feed the catalog tier; geometry is modeled in-house (parametric). No automatable CAD source. Confidence: high.

connectors.name: Potter-Roemer
connectors.notes: Ungated own-site PDF submittals ship as spec now; BIM (RFA/IFC/SKP/DWG) needs an ARCAT account login (set ARCAT_LOGIN). Confidence: medium.

connectors.name: Potter-Electric
connectors.notes: CADENAS native (Revit/STEP, 100+ formats) behind a FREE 3Dfindit account (set THREEDFINDIT_ACCOUNT). Backstop: ungated pottersignal.com datasheet PDFs. JS-rendered — confirm per-part formats with a real session. Confidence: medium.

connectors.name: Watts
connectors.notes: TraceParts API (catalog WATTS_983238924) needs an API Key + Tenant UID (partner-gated; mints a 24h bearer). Native STEP per part. Manufacturer site 403s bots. Fallback: free BIMobject/MEPcontent login. Confidence: medium.

connectors.name: Reliable
connectors.notes: Own FTP ZIP tree (soft lead-gen gate only, directly addressable). Revit .rfa ONLY — feeds the BIM tier, NOT the STEP tier. Optional free BIMobject/3Dfindit account for cross-check. Confidence: high.

connectors.name: Viking
connectors.notes: TraceParts API (VIKING_EMEA) needs an API Key + Tenant UID for the EMEA line (native STEP/IGES/SW/Revit/DWG). US Viking Corp SKUs via free BIMobject + 3Dfindit accounts. Confidence: high.

connectors.name: Wheatland
connectors.notes: ARCAT ungated BIM (RFA/RVT + CAD DWG/IFC) + wheatland.com submittal PDFs. No login, no key. Respect ARCAT 429 rate-limit — verify download flow with a real browser session first. Confidence: medium.

connectors.name: Bull Moose
connectors.notes: Ungated PDFs only (bullmoosetube.com/wp-content/uploads/) — NO 3D exists. Parametric pipe is synthesized in-house from parsed dimensional tables; feeds the spec/catalog tier, geometry generated in-house. Confidence: high.
